title: A recurrent two-linkage binary model defeats naive single-last-mark gluing
statement_preview_not_a_proof: For the native binary two-linkage network0<->A with rates k_plus,k_minus and A+B<->A+C with rates u,v>0, class A=n>=0,B+C=1, the exact invariant probability is Poisson(k_plus/k_minus) times B/C weights(v,u)/(u+v), with detailed balance on e
